first_experiment.instructions: Choose the single candidate most likely to improve decode throughput enough to test first, using the measured RADV GTT/VRAM and forced-offload evidence. Do not invent a candidate.

criteria.cpu_only_t8: Disable Vulkan and run all layers on the 8-thread CPU.
criteria.cpu_only_t16: Disable Vulkan and run all layers on 16 CPU threads.
criteria.vulkan_full_fa_off: Keep full Vulkan offload but disable flash attention.
criteria.vulkan_hybrid_32: Offload 32 transformer layers and run the rest on CPU.
criteria.vulkan_hybrid_48: Offload 48 transformer layers and run the rest on CPU.
criteria.vulkan_weights_cpu_kv: Keep weights on Vulkan and move the KV cache to CPU.

cpu_path_promising.instructions: Given the measurements, is a CPU-only candidate more likely than the deployed full-Vulkan candidate to improve token generation throughput?

confidence_level.instructions: Rate confidence that the first selected candidate will beat 1.2022 decode tokens/s on the real K16.
